text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (May 22, 2025) for 1501 Woodbine Avenue, 110.

The Property Standards Committee – Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed Items 1, 2, and 4 of the Property Standards Order (May 22, 2025) for 1501 Woodbine Avenue, 110, Folder Number 25 164089 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to July 25, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City. 2. Confirmed Items 3 and 5 of the Property Standards Order (May 22, 2025) for 1501 Woodbine Avenue, 110, Folder Number 25 164089 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to October 31, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
